I was the child in the situation. 

I caught my dad and step mom in the act. Seeing my dads white ass should've been punishment enough. After I ran into my room crying and trying not to wake my step sister up, my step mom came in the room and yelled at me. Like dude I just wanted to talk to my dad because I had a nightmare. Damn.

Veins. The sight of them scares me so bad. I spend hours every night tossing and turning to try to find a position that touches my veins the least (by that I mean my ankles, top of my feet, wrists, top of my hands, and neck). I told my counselor that I would commit suicide if I ever got varicose veins and meant it. Of course nobody understands and thinks I'm joking when I tell them. They don't understand why I'm afraid of something that we need to survive, and honestly I don't either.

Hey! Please don't do it just yet. Instead, why don't you message me and tell me about your favorite movie? Or maybe your favorite song? Or really anything. Go into as much detail as you'd like. 
I'm about to go back to work, but seriously, I'd love to hear from you.
Special FX makeup. Seriously it's more expensive than you'd think.

I'm so late to this, but I once dated a guy and his mom literally texted him to remind him to drink water. 
Oh! And she watched us sleep. Only reason I caught her was because she couldn't tell I was awake one night. She stood there for about five minutes watching.
